item.title: From Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
item.description:

item.title: [News] Enabling a new model for healthcare with AI co-clinician
item.description: Google DeepMind has developed an AI co-clinician to aid in healthcare. This AI co-clinician is part of ongoing research to enable AI-augmented care.

item.title: [News] Four ways Google Research scientists have been using Empirical Research Assistance
item.description: Four ways Google Research scientists have been using Empirical Research Assistance, a set of tools to streamline research processes. This includes a tool for data collection and another for data validation.

item.title: [News] Unlocking human ambition to drive business growth with AI
item.description: Microsoft emphasizes integrating AI tools, such as Copilots and agents, with daily workflows to unlock creativity and accelerate innovation. This enables businesses to reinvent themselves and drive growth.

item.title: [News] Microsoft Sovereign Private Cloud scales to thousands of nodes with Azure Local
item.description: Microsoft has scaled Azure Local to support deployments of up to thousands of servers within a single sovereign environment.

item.title: [News] Announcing our partnership with the Republic of Korea
item.description: Google DeepMind and the Republic of Korea have announced a partnership to accelerate scientific breakthroughs using frontier AI models. This partnership aims to push the boundaries of AI research and development.
